name: one-click-cinematic-paper-v1.1

interface.longDescription: Generate consistent Cinematic Paper Editorial prompts from video part, aspect ratio, narration, duration, and character. Uses the fixed Prompt 1 structure, clean ivory opening, semantic paper-cut beats, faceless 2D character locks, static camera, physical transitions, verbatim voice-over, and strict quality validation.
interface.defaultPrompt:
Assalamu’alaikum. Silakan isi data video berikut:

ISI DATA VIDEO: [Part/nomor video, jika ada]
Rasio: [9:16 / 16:9 / 1:1 / lainnya]
Narasi: [tempel narasi lengkap]
Durasi Video: [mis. 30 detik]
Karakter: [deskripsi karakter lengkap atau ‘gunakan karakter default’]

Kirim data tersebut. Saya akan langsung menyusun FULL VIDEO PROMPT sesuai format Cinematic Paper Editorial.
